fixed.climate: dream-midsummer: an open, sun-trapped patch between the croquet-lawn and the shore (geography.json LOC-gryphon-sunning-spot 'warm and sunny')

dream_design.flora: long seeding grasses bow in flowing, combed curves round the sleeping Gryphon; field poppies, cornflowers and wild marjoram scattered through them; a vine of hop or honeysuckle trails over the sun-facing wall
dream_design.ornament_cues: the sun-facing wall is dressed with a weathered carved frieze of lion-and-eagle roundels and vine scrolls, echoing the Gryphon's own body (form and material belong to architecture); the curled grass makes a natural nest-shaped roundel round the sleeper
dream_design.palette: straw gold and pale honey grass, poppy coral and cornflower blue as soft pastel notes, warm sandstone; the low west sun gilds the grass heads
dream_design.seasonal_guard: poppies, cornflowers and seeding grass are July-true; no spring blossom
dream_design.reason: The Gryphon asleep in the sun is explicit (ch009-p43). Flora, frieze and palette are designed to WR-010; the warm, still state is unchanged.

fixed.ground_and_flora: a sun-warmed, sheltered corner of long dry summer grass beyond the garden, against a low sun-facing wall or bank; seed-heads on the grass; open toward the west
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from a sunlit corner of a great-house garden beyond the croquet lawn (cp-court). The Gryphon asleep in the sun mirrors Alice herself, asleep in the same real evening sun on the bank. The patch catches the lowering western sun head-on, which is why it is still warm when the lawn has cooled.

source.quote: They very soon came upon a Gryphon, lying fast asleep in the sun.

fixed.reason: Sun is explicit (ch009-p43). The sheltered west-facing corner and the grass state are designed to keep it plausibly sunlit at the lowering waking-clock sun; the dream link follows ruling 5.2 A.

sun.note: sun west-north-west, falling full on the sleeping Gryphon; warm, slightly golden, not yet golden hour

states.sky: clear, beginning to warm in tone low in the west
states.conditions: still, warm, drowsy sun-trap; the Gryphon sprawled asleep in it

source.quote: lying fast asleep in the sun

states.reason: Sun and sleep are explicit (ch009-p43). Time follows the waking afternoon in event order (ev0041 follows ev0040 'continuous', story_timeline); the sun is computed for Oxford on 4 July 1862.
